name: Irredeemable
source:
Meliora is only four days away from ascending to the position of Regis, the highest office in the city of Monumenta. The city's people believe she is pure and virtuous, a blessed and uncorrupted soul worthy of their admiration.

Nothing could be further from the truth.

Meliora has left a trail of betrayal and sacrifice behind her on her climb to the top. And now, she has captured Monumenta's most notorious serial killer: Viscerine, Death's Damsel, the Terror of the Alley of Whispers. Meliora plans to make a sacrifice of Viscerine, to torture her as a way to erase her past sins and strengthen herself against her own doubts and fears.

But Viscerine proves to be far more alluring than Meliora expected. Soon, pain and passion intertwine, and instead of banishing the darkness from herself, Meliora finds that she may lose herself to it entirely… 

[From [url=https://dumbsuccubus.itch.io/irredeemable]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离梅莉奥拉登临丰碑城最高权位“执政王”仅剩四天。全城百姓都深信她纯洁高尚，是一颗受神明眷顾、纤尘不染的圣洁灵魂，值得万众敬仰。

然而事实却截然相反。

在一步步爬上权力巅峰的途中，梅莉奥拉身后早已留下了累累背叛与牺牲。而如今，她擒获了丰碑城最臭名昭著的连环杀手：维瑟琳——人称“死神侍女”、“低语巷的梦魇”。梅莉奥拉盘算着拿维瑟琳充当祭品，通过对她施以酷刑来洗刷自己过往的罪孽，并借此淬炼心志、压制内心深处的动摇与恐惧。

谁知维瑟琳远比梅莉奥拉预想中更加魅惑动人。很快，痛楚与情欲紧密交织；非但未能驱散自身的黑暗，梅莉奥拉反而发觉自己正濒临彻底迷失其中的边缘……

[摘自[url=https://dumbsuccubus.itch.io/irredeemable]itch.io[/url]]
